title: The Red Shoes
creator: Michael Powell & Emeric Pressburger
description: A young ballerina torn between love and her art, in the British classic famous for its 17-minute ballet sequence. Part of it was filmed at the Monte Carlo Opera and on the coast nearby.

title: The Mystery of Picasso
creator: Henri-Georges Clouzot
description: Le Mystère Picasso: Clouzot films Picasso painting on translucent paper from behind, so the pictures appear and change on screen. It was shot at the Victorine studios in Nice.

title: GoldenEye
creator: Martin Campbell
description: Pierce Brosnan’s first film as James Bond opens its story in Monte Carlo, with baccarat in the casino and a yacht in the harbor.

title: Grand Prix
creator: John Frankenheimer
description: A drama about Formula One drivers, famous for its racing footage, which opens at the 1966 Monaco Grand Prix with cameras mounted on the cars as they race through the streets.

title: Dirty Rotten Scoundrels
creator: Frank Oz
description: Michael Caine and Steve Martin as rival con men working rich women on the Riviera. The fictional town of Beaumont-sur-Mer was filmed in Beaulieu-sur-Mer, Villefranche, and Antibes.

title: E.1027: Eileen Gray and the House by the Sea
creator: Beatrice Minger & Christoph Schaub
description: The story of E-1027, the modernist house by the sea that Irish designer Eileen Gray built in 1929, and of Le Corbusier, who painted murals on its walls without asking and later built a cabin next door.
